page.overview:
Who is Baxter Stockman?

Baxter Stockman is a brilliant but mad scientist, often allied with the Shredder and/or Krang. In almost every version, he is depicted as the creator of the Mousers, and an enemy of the . In most incarnations, he is forced into an alternate form (he is either converted into a cyborg or mutated into a fly) that causes his sanity to erode even further.
